title: Put the checks in order
prompt:
outcome is handed what each stage of the compiler found out about one file: its size in bytes, whether it parses, how many nodes and source edges it has, whether it is valid, its static cost, the value it computes (got) and the value its assert expects (want). It returns the one word the compiler prints.

Every check is here with the right limit, but they run in the wrong order. Put them in the order of the list above. Then repair the last line: a program that runs is not always a MATCH.

tests.expr: outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=True, cost=3, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=True, cost=3, got=4, want=5)
outcome(size=5000, parses=False, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=True, cost=3, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=False, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=True, cost=3, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=100, edges=6, valid=False, cost=3, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=5, edges=300, valid=False, cost=3, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=99, edges=299, valid=False, cost=3, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=False, cost=2000000, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=40, parses=True, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=True, cost=1000000, got=5, want=5)
outcome(size=4096, parses=True, nodes=5, edges=6, valid=True, cost=999999, got=-1, want=-1)

hints: Number the six steps from the list in the lesson, then find each one in the code. Which step is first in the list and third in the code?
The order is: size, parses, nodes and edges, valid, cost, run. Move whole `if` blocks. You do not need to change any limit.
The last line is `return "MATCH" if got == want else "MISMATCH"`.
explain: The six checks run in one fixed order and the first one that decides wins: the byte limit, then parsing, then the node and edge counts, then validation, then the cost limit, and only then the run. A file that is too big is `OVERBUDGET` even if it also has a typo, because nobody reads it far enough to see the typo. `MATCH` or `MISMATCH` is decided last, by comparing the two values.
